provenance.source: Translated from the Latin of Augustine's De spiritu et littera (412), canonical edition content/works/augustine-de-spiritu-et-littera/edition-la.json (edition 01M6N296SQ9VRJPZDX923CRAJ7): the Latin of the 1914 Clarendon Press edition (William Bright), without the editor's English introduction, summaries, notes and apparatus. Made from the Latin, not from another translation: the public-domain English translations of 1887 (the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers volume and the D. Nutt volume of the inventory, P2D-12) are reference for the critic only and are not copied.
